sent_bad: So, per the document, the mechanism is that the local (Wi‑Fi) network protocols are not sufficiently protected, and apps can use them as side-channels to query other devices on the network and collect data that app permissions were supposed to keep protected.
Note: the document says apps can have "direct access to everything else on that network" — it does not use the word "control," and it does not state that a device can control other devices.
